files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
Models get thumbnails in Files without anyone opening them: the browser of whoever is viewing a folder renders them in the background, within limits each user sets. A thumbnail is kept once per file version and shown to everyone who can see the file, including share recipients and public links. VRML files, FreeCAD files saved by FreeCAD and FBX files with embedded textures open correctly again. Existing thumbnails turn back into icons after the upgrade and are made again as folders are browsed.

### Added
- **Thumbnails are made while you browse Files.** Models in the folder you are viewing get a thumbnail without being opened: one file at a time, while the browser is idle and the tab is visible, and not while Save-Data is on or a model is open in the viewer. Folders without models load none of this code. Each model is rendered in its own Web Worker, which is stopped the moment it runs out of time, so a large CAD file never freezes the page. Personal Settings → 3D Viewer → Thumbnails has the new options: "Create thumbnails while browsing Files" (on by default, and separate from making thumbnails in the viewer), "Skip files larger than" (50 MB), "Give up on a file after" (30 seconds) and "Download at most, per folder visit" (500 MB). A file that runs out of time or cannot be read is skipped by this browser until the file changes or you press "Retry skipped files"; network and server errors never skip a file, and a browser that cannot render in a worker downloads nothing at all. Only the companion files a model names (materials, textures, glTF buffers) are downloaded, and only while they fit in the folder budget, so a model whose textures are not named gets an untextured thumbnail. A model is never rendered without a companion it names, since a thumbnail is kept for the file's version: one that does not fit in what is left of the budget waits for your next visit to the folder, and one that cannot be found beside the model (or at the path it names) is left for the viewer, which looks further, to make the first thumbnail. In Favorites, Shares and Tags, thumbnails are made once you open a folder, not on their top-level lists. Only files you can edit get a thumbnail. 3MF, AMF, DAE and X3D files, whose loaders cannot run in a worker, and `.nc` and `.g` files, which may not be G-code at all, still get theirs when opened in the viewer.

### Changed
- One thumbnail per file version, shared by everyone who can see the file. Thumbnails were stored per user, keyed by file id alone, so each user made their own and an edited file kept its old picture. They are now stored once per version in the app data (`thumbnails-v2/<fileId>/`), dropped when the file is edited or deleted, and the old per-user thumbnails are removed on upgrade. Models that showed a thumbnail before the upgrade show their file icon again until a new thumbnail is made, by browsing their folder or opening them.
- The viewer captures a model's thumbnail with the same fixed look as every other thumbnail (transparent background, default lighting and camera framing) instead of a crop of the live canvas, and only once per file version: it asks the server first and skips files you cannot edit, files that already have a thumbnail for their current version, public shares, and opens that took a material or texture from the browser's dependency cache, which may be older than the file. It now covers every format the viewer opens, not a fixed list of 12.
- The CAD runtime chunk is 63 KB instead of 776 KB. The OCCT glue's `require("crypto")`, reached only when it runs under Node, pulled the whole browser polyfill for Node's `crypto` into the bundle: crypto-browserify, bn.js, elliptic, asn1.js and readable-stream. `crypto` is no longer polyfilled, which also removes the `vm-browserify` eval warning from the build.
- The GLB, STL and OBJ exporters load when an export starts instead of with the viewer, taking 40 KB off the main chunk. The slicer's dynamic imports of the same exporters had no effect while the export composable imported them statically.
- webdav 5.10.0 → 5.11.0 and fast-xml-parser 5.10.1 → 5.11.2, which drop a duplicate key the build warned about.
- "Retry skipped files" replaces "Clear thumbnails" in the thumbnail settings. Thumbnails are now shared, so clearing them would have removed other people's too; a thumbnail goes away when its file changes instead.
- `roave/security-advisories` is no longer a dev dependency. Its latest release declares a conflict with every PHP below 8.2.35, PHP 8.1 included, so Composer could not resolve the dev tree for the app's minimum PHP and every PHP job in CI failed at install. Advisories are still checked by `composer audit` in the security scan.

### Fixed
- IFC, FCSTD and G-code files never showed a thumbnail in Files. The preview provider registered for `model/*` MIME types only, and these three have `application/x-step`, `application/x-fcstd` and `text/x-gcode`. It now registers for the MIME type of every format that gets a thumbnail.
- Thumbnails never showed to share recipients or on public links. They were looked up for the logged-in user, so a recipient saw their own (usually none) and a public link, with no user, saw none at all. Anyone who can see a file now sees its thumbnail.
- FreeCAD files (`.fcstd`) saved by FreeCAD failed to open with "FCSTD archive contains no .brep geometry entries". FreeCAD stores each body as a `.brp` file inside the document, and only `.brep` was read; both are now.
- VRML files (`.wrl`, `.vrml`) spun for 30 seconds and then failed to open in the viewer. The loader waited for a callback three.js's VRML loader never calls; it now uses the scene the parser returns, so they open.
- FBX files with embedded textures opened untextured. The images the file carries were looked up by name among the companion files, matched nothing, and got a blank placeholder; they are now used as they are.

### Security
- A model rendered in the background loads only the files it was given. A texture or buffer it named but that was not among them was requested from the URL the model wrote, so a model in a shared folder could make the browser of anyone browsing that folder request an address of its author's choosing. The worker now refuses every URL except the model's own files and the app's decoders, before any request is made, and skips the model.
- Storing a thumbnail requires the request token (CSRF protection) and edit rights on the file. The upload route opted out of CSRF checks, and anyone who could read a file could set its thumbnail; read-only share recipients now get 403. The browser also sends the version it rendered, which it learns before it starts downloading the model, and an upload for a version that is no longer current is refused, so a thumbnail can never be filed under a newer version of the file.
- Dependencies updated within their existing ranges to clear `npm audit`: follow-redirects 1.16.0 → 1.16.2 (credential headers kept across cross-origin redirects), reached through axios's Node adapter, which the browser bundle does not use, and vite 7.3.6 → 7.3.7 (dev-server advisories). Dev-only fast-uri, brace-expansion, js-yaml, moment, pbkdf2 and qs move to patched releases as well.
